messages.subject: unable to execute .R files via rapache
messages.subject_clean: unable to execute .R files via rapache
messages.body_plain:
Hi everybody, I am trying to execute test.R file using rapache. I have this in my httpd.conf file:
    <Location "/R">
      SetHandler r-script
        RHandler sys.source
    </Location>
This is the content of test.R, very simple:

<%
x<-1:10000
t=plot(x)
print(t)
%>
when enter, http://<localhost>/R/test.R <http://%3Clocalhost%3E/R/test.R> to the url, I get Internal Server error. Apache log says this:
Traceback:
2: parse(n = -1, file = file)
1: sys.source(file = "/usr/local/apache2/htdocs/R/test.R", envir = .rAenv)

any ideas, what I am missing? Thanks in advance.

messages.subject: Re: unable to execute .R files via rapache

messages.body_plain:
About the 1st one, which browser you're using for development? I know that Firefox tends to keep stuff in cache, so it's a good practice to reload the page by bypassing the cache (Shift + click on reload button, or Ctrl + Shift + R). And dunno which OS are you using, but oftentimes you can just reload configuration, without restarting, e.g, I use Arch Linux, and I can do: rc.d reload httpd. But still, that shouldn't happen.

aL3xa

messages.body_plain:
I have this code that runs in the brew file:

library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(Cairo)

x <- data.frame(read.table("/R/output/output.txt", sep=",", header=T))
y <- melt(x, id=c("Hostname", "Date", "MetricType"))
y$value <-as.numeric(y$value)
yy <- dcast(y, Hostname + Date + variable ~ MetricType,
fun.aggregate=mean)
yy$variable <- as.integer(gsub('Hour', '', yy$variable))
yy$variable <- paste(yy$variable, ":00:00", sep='')
yy$Date <- as.Date(yy$Date, format='%m/%d/%Y')
yy$Date <- paste(yy$Date, yy$variable)
db1 <- subset(yy, yy$Hostname=="server1")
db1<-data.frame(db1)
db1$Date <-as.POSIXct(db1$Date, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz="EST")

filename <- paste(tempfile(tmpdir='/usr/local/apache2/htdocs'),
'.png', sep='')
CairoPNG(filename)
qplot(Date, CPUAVG, data=db1, geom=c("line", "smooth"), method = "lm",
ylab="AVG CPU", xlab="Date", main="server1 CPU AVG")
panel.background = theme_blank()
dev.off()

when the image is create, the browser displays the image as a dark
square. Any ideas?

print(qplot(Date, CPUAVG, data=db1, geom=c("line", "smooth"), method = "lm",

The R command line does this automatically for you, but not rApache.

Jeff

messages.subject: Re: tryCatch Problem
messages.body_plain:
Sorry, it is me again to the same topic (and thanks for your fast answers, Jeffrey!!):

Something is strange about try and catch in Rapache, which I tried to reconstruct with two simple example errors:

For some errors, the errormessage is printed correctly in the browser (Example 1), but for
other errors the error message is sent to the error log (Example 2):
Example 1 (error message is catched &  shown (as it should) in the browser):
<%
showList <- function(){

print(k)
# of course, k is not defined yet

}
printError <- function(e){
print(e$message)
}
tryCatch(showList(),error=printError)
%>

Example 2 (the error message("unexpected symbol") is not catched and is sent to the error.log file
-> not shown  in the browser, which leads to an 500 internal error in Firefox)
<%
showList <- function(){

no List = 3
#should have been noList=3

}
printError <- function(e){
print(e$message)
}
tryCatch(showList(),error=printError)
%>

Does anyone know, why this happens or know how to get along with this behaviour? ( i am working on a web application with Rapache and some errors are just not catched and the app is crashing in an error case...)

Thanks for your help !!

> functions makes me a bit nervous. Consider rewriting your example like

>     'Works!'
> }
>
> printError <- function(e){

> }

>
